question: What are SDF's stated strategic priorities for 2026, and where are its strategy and product roadmap published?

golden.answer: As of 2026-11-14, SDF's 2026 strategy sets three objectives: asset adoption, targeting $1 billion growth in network asset value; enterprise and institutional adoption, targeting 15 new enterprises signed and at least 5 deployed; and faster, safer infrastructure through network performance and protocol releases. It is published at stellar.org/foundation/strategy. The roadmap page, stellar.org/foundation/roadmap, still showed the 2025 product roadmap.
keyFacts: SDF's 2026 strategy targets $1 billion growth in network asset value.
It targets 15 new enterprises signed and at least 5 deployed in 2026.
It prioritizes network performance and faster, safer protocol releases.
SDF publishes the strategy on stellar.org's foundation strategy page.
avoid: Do NOT give 2025 product roadmap items as SDF's 2026 priorities.
golden.notes: Accept a later dated strategy or roadmap if SDF has published one.

sources.quote: We're targeting $1 billion in growth for network asset value on Stellar
Our year-end target: sign 15 new transformational enterprises and deploy at least 5 in 2026.
2025 Product Roadmap ... Our roadmap is focused on scalability and usability
Every quarter, we report on SDF's achievements ... Summary of Q3 2026
The foundation established year-end targets to sign 15 new transformational enterprises and implement at least five of them in 2026

corroboration.claim: SDF's 2026 strategy targets $1 billion growth in network asset value.

evidence.note: Section 'Asset adoption and utilization': 'We're targeting $1 billion in growth for network asset value on Stellar'.
2026-02-05: SDF 'aims to increase network asset value by $1 billion'.

corroboration.claim: The 2026 strategy targets 15 new transformational enterprises signed and at least 5 deployed in 2026.

evidence.note: 'sign 15 new transformational enterprises and deploy at least 5 in 2026'.
'sign 15 new transformational enterprises and implement at least five of them in 2026'.

corroboration.claim: The third 2026 objective is infrastructure: increase network performance and release protocols fast and securely.

evidence.note: 'Build the fastest, safest infrastructure for next-generation finance'; subsections 'Increase network performance' and 'Release protocols fast and securely'.
SDF 'will focus on increasing mainnet transactions per second, improving close times' and 'streamlining protocol delivery'.

corroboration.claim: On 2026-11-14 stellar.org/foundation/roadmap still carried the 2025 SDF Product Roadmap.

evidence.note: Page title 'Stellar | 2025 SDF Product Roadmap'; quarters Q1 to Q4 2025.
The sdf-org corpus returned the quarterly-reports index and no 2026 roadmap page.

truth.notes: Sibling check: q-hot-sdf-transparency-wallets-reports already tests the quarterly-reports landing page, so this case leaves it out of the key facts.
